propositions: Container tickets rarely declare their own file_impact, so their plan-review attestation falls back to whole-HEAD invalidation where any unrelated commit forces re-review.
Containers should inherit their DIRECT children's declared file_impact into the signed dependency set (union of own file_impact, review citations, and direct children's file_impact).
A poison rule keeps the pre-change dependency set (fail-closed whole-HEAD fallback) when any non-closed direct child has empty file_impact.
Closed children neither contribute file paths nor poison the inherited union.
Inheritance is limited to direct children because the pin lattice self-heals only one level deep; recursive whole-subtree inheritance would leave grandchild drift silently stale.
P9 (p9_file_impact_coverage) emits a non-blocking advisory naming children with empty file_impact when container inheritance is poisoned, instead of unconditionally auto-passing containers.
